notes: National rules, with IRAP owed to the company's region. Dates assume a calendar financial year unless stated.

items.name: Approval of the Financial Statements (bilancio)
items.rule: Within 120 days after financial year end (180 days where the by-laws allow)
items.applies: S.r.l., S.r.l.s. and S.p.A.
items.description: The shareholders' meeting approves the statements.

items.name: Financial Statements Filed with the Business Register (Registro Imprese)
items.rule: Within 30 days of approval
items.applies: S.r.l., S.r.l.s. and S.p.A.; branches file the foreign company's accounts
items.description: Filed in XBRL through the Chamber of Commerce.

items.name: Annual Tax on Company Books (tassa libri sociali)
items.rule: 16 March
items.applies: S.r.l., S.r.l.s. and S.p.A.
items.description: A flat annual government fee paid with form F24.

items.name: Income Tax and IRAP Returns (Redditi SC and IRAP)
items.rule: Last day of the 10th month after financial year end (31 October for a calendar year)
items.applies: Companies and branches
items.description: Filed electronically.

items.name: IRES — Balance and First Advance Payment
items.rule: Last day of the 6th month after financial year end (30 June for a calendar year)
items.applies: Companies and branches
items.description: Paid with form F24; payment within the following 30 days carries a 0.4% surcharge.

items.name: IRES — Second Advance Payment
items.rule: Last day of the 11th month of the financial year (30 November for a calendar year)
items.applies: Companies and branches
items.description: Paid with form F24.

items.name: Income Tax Return (Redditi PF / Redditi SP)
items.rule: 31 October
items.applies: Sole proprietors and partnerships
items.description: Partnerships file Redditi SP and the partners report their shares.

items.name: IRPEF — Balance and Advance Payments
items.rule: 30 June (balance and first advance) and 30 November (second advance)
items.applies: Sole proprietors and partners
items.description: Paid with form F24.

items.name: INPS Contributions for Artisans and Traders
items.rule: 16 May, 20 August, 16 November and 16 February
items.applies: Sole proprietors and working partners enrolled as artisans or traders
items.description: Fixed quarterly contributions on the minimum income; contributions above it are paid with the income tax.

items.name: Chamber of Commerce Annual Fee (diritto annuale)
items.rule: 30 June (with the income tax balance)
items.applies: Every business on the Business Register
items.description: Paid with form F24.

items.name: Annual VAT Return
items.rule: Between 1 February and 30 April
items.applies: Businesses charging VAT
items.description: The annual VAT balance is due by 16 March.

items.name: Quarterly VAT Settlement Communications (LIPE)
items.rule: 31 May, 30 September, 30 November and the end of February
items.applies: Businesses charging VAT
items.description: Reports each period's VAT settlement.

items.name: VAT Advance Payment (acconto IVA)
items.rule: 27 December
items.applies: Businesses charging VAT
items.description: An advance on the last settlement of the year.

items.name: VAT Settlement and Payment (monthly)
items.rule: 16th of the following month
items.applies: Businesses on monthly VAT settlements
items.description: Paid with form F24.

items.name: VAT Settlement and Payment (quarterly)
items.rule: 16 May, 20 August, 16 November, and 16 March for the fourth quarter
items.applies: Smaller businesses that chose quarterly settlements
items.description: Paid with form F24 with 1% interest.

items.name: Payroll Withholding Tax and INPS Contributions (F24)
items.rule: 16th of the following month
items.applies: Employers
items.description: Tax withheld from wages and social contributions are paid with form F24.

items.name: Monthly Contribution Report (UniEmens)
items.rule: Last day of the following month
items.applies: Employers
items.description: Reports each employee's pay and contributions to INPS.

items.name: Employee Tax Certificates (Certificazione Unica)
items.rule: 16 March
items.applies: Employers and businesses that paid professionals
items.description: Sent to the tax agency and given to each recipient.

items.name: Withholding Agents' Return (Modello 770)
items.rule: 31 October
items.applies: Employers and businesses that withheld tax
items.description: Summarises the year's withholding taxes and payments.

items.name: INAIL Self-Assessment (autoliquidazione)
items.rule: Premium by 16 February; wage declaration by the end of February
items.applies: Employers
items.description: The workplace accident insurance premium is settled for the past year and advanced for the current one.

items.name: Transfer Pricing Documentation
items.rule: Signed and time-stamped by the date the income tax return is filed
items.applies: Companies with cross-border related-party transactions
items.description: A master file and local file in the prescribed form give penalty protection; possession is declared in the tax return.

items.name: IRAP — Regional Tax on Productive Activities (Abruzzo)
items.rule: Balance and first advance by 30 June; second advance by 30 November (calendar financial year)
items.applies: Companies and partnerships producing in Abruzzo
items.description: IRAP is owed to the region where the business produces, at the rate Abruzzo sets; businesses active in several regions split the tax base between them in the IRAP return.
